name: Chaw
source:
A director of a major system development company in Hong Kong where Ash worked.
He was banned from the Amaryllis nightclub after he tried to force a hostess into his hotel room.
Yvet and her team kidnap him in order to access the company's network via his laptop and obtain a personnel list.
